Marlow Ridge Partners is seeking an Acquisitions Analyst to join ourWest Coast investment team. You will underwrite multifamily and mixed-use opportunitiesacross Southern California.

What you’ll do

  • Build and maintain cash-flow models for prospective acquisitions
  • Prepare investment committee memoranda & supporting analyses
  • Coordinate due diligence with lenders, brokers and third-party consultants
  • Track submarket fundamentals — rents, absorption, cap rates

What we look for

  • 2–4 years in real estate acquisitions, investment banking or valuation
  • Advanced Excel; Argus a plus
  • Bachelor's degree in finance, economics or a related field

Base salary range: $95,000–$115,000 plus discretionary bonus.
